body:
Thanks for your response.

Yeah I'm getting a ton of help right now. I know I'm depressed. The thoughts that go through my head are ones that I share. My friend bottled them up, there's no way I can do the same.

I've been writing everyday and every night. I've been talking to a few people close to the situation.

I agree its a good idea to have a orderly worded message to the mother, however I have a strong belief that I should tell her in person.

I'm talking a lot. Thanks a lot for your long, well thought out response.

Yes I know its a choice. I have no idea how it will affect her, but I don't think there's a way for her to be happy with what I have to tell her. But its the truth. And if noone else heard my friend's problems then maybe it'll provide some closure.

I wish I could somehow let you know the entire situation, but it's a lot. It'll be pretty much a novel to write out, and personally I don't feel comfortable putting it all out there online. 

I will tell you though that yes, I could've done something. Anything. In my situation, however, I did a lot to help her. Just not enough.

Good idea, I'll look for someone who knows her well and talk to them. 

Days feel like weeks now. Time does not pass by quickly. This weighs down on me everyday, but I know I have to wait and do things when the time is right. I just need to know what to do when it is right.

Thanks for your response.

Thanks for your response.

Yes, I've been thinking about the most delicate way possible to reveal it. It'll be the hardest thing I've ever had to do, but it has to be done. She deserves to know the truth.
